            n += 1

            # These marked bars terminate with background at the right edge.

    return out
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    fg = next(v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v != bg)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        runs=[]; n=0
        for v in row+[bg]:
            if v==fg: n+=1
            else:
                runs.append(n); n=0
        if runs and max(runs)>=len(row)//4 and row[-1]==bg and row.count(fg)>0:
            # Continue the long foreground bar with the contrasting marker.
            last=max(i for i,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg)
            if max(runs)>=len(row)//4 and all(v==bg for v in row[last+1:]):
                for c in range(last+1,len(row)): out[r][c]=1
    return out
'''
